applicability.rationale: The requested format is externally required, but its outcome and verification still need to be explicit.

assumptions: The published R-17 specification is current
Internal data contains every required field
falsifiers: The regulator rejects a schema-valid sample
causalHypothesis.mechanism: A deterministic mapping creates the mandated schema and validates it before submission.
causalHypothesis.statement: Generating R-17 directly from validated internal records will reduce conversion errors and produce an acceptable submission.

constraints.statement: The final submission must conform to regulator schema R-17.

counterfactual.conclusion: The mandated format is necessary but not sufficient; semantic mapping and acknowledged submission must also be verified.
failureConditions: The file is schema-valid but semantically wrong
counterfactual.question: If an R-17 file is produced, when would the compliance outcome still fail?
residualRisks: External schema changes require monitored updates

costsAndPain: Manual conversion is slow and error-prone
currentBaseline.description: The team exports internal data and manually converts it into the regulator format.

desiredOutcomes.statement: The reporting authority accepts the monthly submission without manual reformatting or schema rejection.
successMeasures: Receipt is acknowledged before the deadline

disposition.rationale: The output form is mandated; the implementation must also prove semantic correctness and acknowledgement.
disposition.selectedDirection: Generate, validate, and submit regulator schema R-17 with semantic mapping tests and receipt tracking.

requestedIntervention.rationale: The regulator accepts only the published R-17 schema for this reporting obligation.
requestedIntervention.statement: Produce the monthly submission in regulator schema R-17.

criteria: Semantic mapping and receipt are covered

risk.rationale: The external interface and reporting obligation make this consequential despite straightforward implementation.

successEvidence.thresholdOrSignal: All required fields and business rules pass the qualified validator
